Acorn HP1BP, Hand Forged Iron Speakeasy Grille

An intersting and beautiful way to add security to your doors, the Iron Speakeasy Grille mounts over windows built into doors for an old world look. The black iron finish has a lifetime no-rust warranty. Created by using the techniques of the traditional forge, it is fabricated with a rare craftmanship, reminiscent of a time when expert anvil artisans, hammer in hand, transformed pure iron into beautiful yet functional designs. Brilliantly hand crafted, this window grille, made by Acorn, will be sure to add a historic feel to any door.

Specifications of the Speakeasy Iron Grille:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Height: 12"
  • Width: 9"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Includes all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Due to the handmade nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
